name: repo-explorer
description: omgbase repo-explorer demo: browse a repository end to end over the MINIMAL tools profile — tree, rendered documents with block anchors, backlinks, an OQX console, history with client-side diffs, a live change feed, frontmatter edits through plan/execute, task checkboxes written back with one CAS-pinned apply and a session-local compensating undo (Lit 3 + signals, Shoelace, MCP over Streamable HTTP through webdevproxy)
